title: Forecasting in Blockchain-Based Local Energy Markets
article_license: CC BY 4.0 as stated on last page
dataset_license: The source article explicitly releases all data and code freely at QuantLet/BLEM; no separate repository LICENSE file was found. Cite article and download from original repository; do not mislabel dataset CC BY solely from article license.
data_description: Discovergy supplied raw smart-meter observations, aggregated to 3-minute counter snapshots in released files, 2017 full year, 100 consumers and 100 prosumers. This experiment downloads lexicographically first three consumer records only.
geography: German energy-market context and German provider; exact household geographic locations not established from inspected data section. Use Discovergy consumer meters without finer location claim.
interval_units: Author FUN_getData.R converts diff(energy)*1e-10 to consumption in kWh. Use integer subtraction before conversion.
snapshots: All three selected records match exact hourly UTC endpoints; start/end lag is zero, no nearest-neighbor matching or interpolation required. Endpoints CSV preserves both raw timestamps and raw cumulative counters.
